notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
This update contains the following changes:

Amulet of loss has now been updated to not only reduce exp and skill loss at player death, but also to fully protect equipped items. Amulet of loss can now also be bought from Karl and not only be looted.

Blessings are now 10000 gold each instead of 5000 gold.

Now you can no longer lose your starter weapon, club, in case of player death.
